The 'Ears' checkpoint is correctly marked false due to fusion/detachment artifacts. The 'Black mask' checkpoint is correctly marked false as the face is uniformly fawn. The 'Body' and 'Coat texture' checkpoints are correctly marked true as the torso appears anatomically sound. The 'Tail' is correctly marked untestable.

I do not see additional artifacts missed by the Router; the paws are slightly soft but acceptable given the motion/lighting.
alignment_reasoning: While the fine_grained_classifier identified the image as 'bull mastiff' (likely due to body shape and color), the image fails critical taxonomic checkpoints: missing black mask and distorted head structure. Only 2 out of 6 testable checkpoints passed (Body mass, Coat texture). The structural failure of the head significantly reduces alignment despite the classifier's label.
artifact_reasoning: Severe structural collapse in the head/neck region (Severity 4.5) and ear fusion (Severity 3.5) dominate the artifact score.
